caption: The research note shows separate figure references.
eval: app.plugins.plugins['pandoc-crossref-preview'].closeDialogs(); (async () => { const leaf = app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const state = leaf.getViewState(); await leaf.setViewState({type:'markdown',state:{...state.state,mode:'preview'}}); for(let n=0;n<50;n++){ if(leaf.view.containerEl.querySelector('.pcp-reference,.pcp-unresolved')) return 'references ready'; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); } throw new Error('No references rendered'); })()

caption: Pro saves number and prefix profiles by project name.
eval: app.plugins.plugins['pandoc-crossref-preview'].closeDialogs(); (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['pandoc-crossref-preview']; p.pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('pandoc-crossref-preview-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow();p.settings.figurePrefix='Plate'; p.settings.figureStart=7;await p.saveProfile('Absorption paper');p.settings.figurePrefix='Figure';p.settings.figureStart=1;await p.saveProfile('Lab notebook');p.showProfiles();return 'profiles open';})()

caption: Pro saves a separate local label report.
eval: app.plugins.plugins['pandoc-crossref-preview'].closeDialogs(); (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['pandoc-crossref-preview']; p.pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('pandoc-crossref-preview-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow();const path=await p.saveReport();await app.workspace.getLeaf(false).openFile(app.vault.getFileByPath(path));document.querySelectorAll('.notice').forEach(n=>n.remove());return path;})()
